A1.justification: Both PDFs describe RoCo-Sim and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material. V1's supplementary calibration and multi-view figures can be matched to v2's appendices despite relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: V1 reports original detection and late-fusion experiments on RCooper and TUMTraf-V2X, component ablations, and simulation-scale analyses in Tables 2–5 and Figure 5.

after.justification: V2 retains those original experiments and adds quantitative foreground-depth evaluation and rendering comparisons in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The camera calibration procedure, MOAS scorer and checker, DepthSAM, and post-processing framework remain unchanged. Appendix A explains and evaluates the existing DepthSAM component; it does not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Appendix A adds direct foreground-depth estimation as an evaluated task alongside the retained roadside detection tasks. No additional dataset is identified. The 16-camera calibration and RCooper-136 multi-view examples already appeared in v1's supplementary material.

E2.justification: Appendix A introduces a focused component comparison against Depth-Anything, OMNI-DC, and Depth-Anything+PCD Calib. These methods are actually evaluated against DepthSAM in its Table 1. The main BEVHeight and BEVSpread comparisons are unchanged.

E3.justification: The new depth experiment uses a random 30% of foreground LiDAR points as ground truth and the remaining points as input, without training, and reports MAE and REL. Existing detection splits, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and sample counts remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix A adds a targeted analysis of DepthSAM's foreground-depth accuracy and the resulting rendering quality relative to alternative depth maps. Existing component ablations, simulation-scale analyses, and supplementary calibration and multi-view examples are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new random LiDAR holdout specifies an evaluation split, without adding repeated sampling or uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Main Figure 1 changes augmented BEVHeight AP3D50 for RCooper-136 and the combined intersections from 36.04/48.90 to 33.10/37.46, aligning with unchanged Table 2; the old values matched BEVSpread. Appendix Table 1 adds depth results, including DepthSAM MAE/REL of 1.0487/0.0350 versus 5.9703/0.3806 for Depth-Anything+PCD Calib. Tables 2–5 are unchanged, while Section 4.4 retains the old improvement percentages.

T1.justification: The calibration, placement-scoring, segmentation, and depth-calibration mathematics in Equations 1–10 remain equivalent. No new assumptions, proofs, derivations, or mathematical definitions accompany the appendix evaluation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same framework novelty, multi-view simulation capabilities, and claims about simulation outperforming architectural improvements. The headline 83.74% and 83.12% AP70 improvements are unchanged; the additional appendix evidence does not redefine the contributions.

C2.justification: Appendix A adds an explanation of depth completion's dependence on point-cloud density and coverage, positions foreground calibration as addressing these limitations, and connects the depth comparison to rendering quality. The existing limitations concerning asset diversity, traffic trajectories, and cross-intersection generalization remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract narrows the promised release from code and pretrained models to code only, retaining the same address and future-release wording. This changes the stated resource commitment, without establishing any actual availability change. Existing implementation and hardware details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds focused positioning against monocular depth estimation and depth completion, including OMNI-DC. The main related-work discussion and 47-entry bibliography remain unchanged; the new appendix references to Depth-Anything and OMNI-DC appear as unresolved citation markers.

P1.justification: V2 organizes the supplementary material into Sections A–C with explanatory prose, changes several references to 'Camera Extrinsic Optimizer,' and lightly edits the Table 2 caption and conclusion. The main narrative and section organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds an appendix depth-results table and depth/rendering comparison figure. It reduces and relocates the existing multi-view montage and moves the unchanged calibration montage to supplementary Figure 3. Several main figures and tables receive modest sizing or spacing adjustments.

improvement.justification: The new direct depth comparison adds useful evidence for DepthSAM beyond v1's downstream ablations, and Figure 1 corrects the attribution of BEVSpread values to BEVHeight. These provide a limited net improvement. Reporting remains imperfect: Section 4.4 retains the old percentages, new appendix citations are unresolved, and the pretrained-model release promise is removed.
